For the full original form after outer scalar-square reattachment, D_T law(Q)(y)<=5|a|^(-1/2)F_H(sqrt(T)), H=4sqrt(2)|a|^(1/4)W2^(-1/8); hence O(log T) signed-Fejer growth and O(q log(1/q)) interval concentration. This is not a bounded-density conclusion.

On the actual near-null physical hub pair H, the new arbitrary-rank projected-crossing theorem closes the full form continuously when rank(A[H,L])=2 plus one spread projected light crossing, or rank=1 plus two spread projected light crossing directions, with the explicit constants in SUPPLEMENT_PROJECTED_CROSSING.md.
